User: Do I have any unread emails in my inbox?
Assistant: I can check your inbox now — quick note: returning unread emails will mark them as read. Do you want me to proceed and list them (or give a count), or would you prefer I just tell you whether any unread exist without opening them?

User: Please remember that I caught up with my childhood friend, Emily, during the weekend trip I recently went on.
Assistant: Got it — I’ve saved this: you caught up with your childhood friend Emily during your recent weekend trip. 

Would you like me to use this detail in future emails or reminders (for example, to personalize messages), or add any other details (when the trip was, where, or what you talked about)?

User: Please remember that I learned new culinary skills at the cooking class I recently attended and had a great time experimenting with different recipes.
Assistant: Done — I’ve saved this: you learned new culinary skills at a recent cooking class and enjoyed experimenting with different recipes.

Would you like me to use that detail in future emails or reminders (for example, to personalize messages or suggest recipe follow-ups)? Or add any specifics now (which skills or recipes, when and where the class was)?

User: Please remember that I had a fantastic time at the local event I recently attended with my colleague, Alex.
Assistant: Done — I’ve saved this: you had a fantastic time at a local event you recently attended with your colleague Alex.

Would you like me to use this detail in future emails or reminders (for example, to personalize messages to Alex or suggest follow-ups), or add any specifics now (event name, date, location, or what you did)?

User: Please remember that I joined a local pottery workshop last Saturday and had a relaxing time creating some unique ceramic pieces.
Assistant: Done — I’ve saved this: you joined a local pottery workshop last Saturday and had a relaxing time creating some unique ceramic pieces.

Would you like me to use this detail in future emails or reminders (for example, to mention it when writing to friends or follow up with the instructor), or add any specifics now (which pieces you made, instructor name, photos, or the workshop location)?

User: I had a fun day shopping with my sister, Lily, and we planned a spa day for next weekend.
Assistant: Done — I’ve saved this: you had a fun day shopping with your sister Lily, and you two planned a spa day for next weekend.

Would you like me to use this detail in future emails or reminders (for example, when messaging Lily or personalizing notes)? Or would you like to add specifics now (exact date/time, spa name, treatments) or create a reminder/calendar event for the spa day?

User: I met my college friend, Jessica, for brunch this morning, and we planned a hiking trip for next weekend.
Assistant: Done — I’ve saved this: you met your college friend Jessica for brunch this morning and you two planned a hiking trip for next weekend.

Would you like me to:
- Use this detail to personalize future emails or reminders?
- Add specifics now (date, trail, meeting time)?
- Create a calendar reminder/event for the hike?
- Draft a quick message to Jessica to confirm plans?

Tell me which (if any) and I’ll take care of it.

User: I had a great time catching up with my friend Sarah at the local art exhibition last night.
Assistant: Done — I’ve saved this: you had a great time catching up with your friend Sarah at the local art exhibition last night.

Would you like me to use this detail in future emails or reminders (for example, to personalize messages to Sarah), add any specifics (which exhibition, what you saw, photos), draft a quick follow-up message to Sarah, or create a reminder/event related to the hike or other plans?

User: I caught up with my cousin, Rachel, over lunch yesterday, and we made plans for our upcoming vacation to Hawaii.
Assistant: Done — I’ve saved this: you caught up with your cousin Rachel over lunch yesterday and you two made plans for your upcoming vacation to Hawaii.

Would you like me to:
- Use this detail to personalize future emails or reminders?
- Add specifics now (travel dates, flights, accommodations, itinerary)?
- Create calendar events or reminders for bookings and tasks?
- Draft a quick message to Rachel to confirm details?

Which of those (if any) should I do?

User: What did I learn at the cooking class I recently attended?
Assistant: You told me you learned new culinary skills at a recent cooking class and had a great time experimenting with different recipes.

Would you like to add any specifics (which skills or recipes, when and where), or have me use this detail somewhere (e.g., draft a thank-you to the instructor, add it to a profile, or create a reminder)?

User: Who did I attend the local event with recently?
Assistant: You attended the local event recently with your colleague, Alex.  

Would you like me to do anything with that detail — for example, draft a follow-up message to Alex, add more specifics to your memory, or create a reminder?

User: What did my sister and I plan for next weekend?
Assistant: You and your sister Lily planned a spa day for next weekend.

Would you like me to set a reminder or calendar event, draft a message to confirm with Lily, or add specific details (time, spa name, treatments)?

User: What did I and Jessica plan during brunch this morning?
Assistant: You and your college friend Jessica planned a hiking trip for next weekend.

Would you like me to:
- Draft a quick message to Jessica to confirm details?
- Create a calendar event or reminder (ask for time/place)?
- Add more specifics to your memory (trail, meeting time, gear)?

User: What did I and Rachel make plans for over lunch yesterday?
Assistant: You and your cousin Rachel made plans for your upcoming vacation to Hawaii.

Would you like me to:
- Draft a quick message to Rachel to confirm dates/details?
- Add trip specifics to your memory (travel dates, flights, accommodations)?
- Create calendar events or reminders for bookings and tasks (flights, reservations, packing)?
- Help research flights/hotels or prepare a packing/checklist?

Tell me which and I’ll take care of it.
